page.overview:
Who is Shannon Richese?

Shannon Richese is the sister of Pruwet Richese.

Shannon came to the Corrinos' with her parents and mother so her brother could be married to Princess Ynez Corrino. The engagement ceremony went well, but at the engagement party, Pruwet pulled out a thinking machine toy, startling others as the technology was prohibited. When Ynez defended him, Javicco decided they could overlook it and the party continued.

When Shannon learned her brother had been killed, she gathered with her parents and the Corrinos. Then she met up with Constantine and they had sex. She admitted to him that she barely knew Pruwet as their father sent them to different planets, far from each other. Shannon and Constantine both used their union to get information about their families. This is how Shannon learned that Javicco was detaining a suspect in Pruwet's killing, news she relayed to her father, who threatened to withdraw his support in order to try to get Javicco to bring the suspect to him. Javicco told Ferdinand his intel was incorrect and there was no suspect.
